what: Contact-solver measurements, shipped as the fixture behind e39. CPU float64, OMP_NUM_THREADS=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4, one solver family per block. No private data: every number is an iteration count, a wall time, a scene parameter or a between-channel gap from a rigid-body contact benchmark.

disagreement.score: D = sqrt(d_pen^2 + d_slip^2 + d_pos^2), d_pen = range(pen/R)/0.10, d_slip = range(slip_m)/0.02 m, d_pos = max pairwise |pos| / 0.10 m, over five solver channels on the same scene
disagreement.anchor_score: slip_err_m / 0.01 m + pen/R + 10 if the tipping verdict is wrong, against the analytic slip/tipping anchor; lower is closer to the anchor
disagreement.exact_lost: the exact-cone channel lost the scene: another channel scored below it by more than 1.5x
